The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Creates a new app pack with the standard file shape (models, selectors, services, apis, tasks, urls, tests)
- Registers it through the optional-apps environment variable and a manifest declaring all required keys (app, name, optional, dependencies, required_settings, url_prefix, urlconf)
- Mounts routes dynamically so disabling the pack removes its routes

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
